title: docs declaration conflicts with Private only network access requirement
rationale: Declaration property 'tf.public_network_access' is 'enabled', but linked intent requires: "Private only network access — Private only network access required".
decisionsTaken: Narrow PROTECTS/APPLIES_TO edge linked declaration property to intent requirement.

title: Storage or data service 'docs' allows public network access.
rationale: Infrastructure declaration properties on the knowledge graph indicate a security posture risk.
decisionsTaken: Unsafe or weak declaration attribute present on ingested infrastructure object.

title: Workload-conditioned requirement themes are incomplete
rationale: Scope metadata was not stored on the context snapshot; expected requirement themes use the engine baseline default (traceability, availability) plus any policy-stamped themes — not workload-conditioned scope signals.
decisionsTaken: Compared workload-conditioned requirement themes to themes inferred from requirement nodes.

title: Workload security baseline control-family coverage is incomplete
rationale: Scope metadata was not stored on the context snapshot; expected security control families use the engine baseline default (identity-access, network-isolation, logging-monitoring) plus any policy-stamped families — not workload-conditioned scope signals.
decisionsTaken: Compared workload-expected control families to families inferred from active security baseline nodes.

title: Category-scoped security baseline coverage is incomplete
rationale: Workload-expected topology categories use the engine legacy four-pillar default because scope metadata was not stored; missing PROTECTS coverage is measured against that default, not stored workload scope.
decisionsTaken: Compared workload-expected topology categories to categories with protected resources.

title: Security baseline control: Private only network access
rationale: A security baseline node was found; PROTECTS edges associate it with topology resources that should inherit control scope.
decisionsTaken: Included topology targets linked via PROTECTS edges in explainability scope.

title: Topology coverage is incomplete
rationale: Required capabilities, topology hints, and constraints were not stored on the context snapshot; expected topology pillars use the engine legacy four-pillar default (not workload scope metadata).
decisionsTaken: Compared present topology categories to the engine legacy four-pillar default because scope metadata was not stored.
